children: The Canadian dollar strengthened against the greenback on Thursday, and the yield on benchmark government debt slipped.
was trading 0% higher at C$1.3982 to the greenback, or 71.52 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3982 to 1.4001.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) fell 9.8 basis points to 3.843%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt fell to 4.9528%.
futures fell $2.46 to $99.97 a barrel on Thursday.
